messages:
maria: Heads up — onboarding sampleapp failing on JSON mode function/tool calls in Node SDK. Parser throws `Unexpected token` when schema expects an object.

jordan: Oof. Is this the json_mode flag parity issue we've seen before? Which repo/sample?

maria: samplekit v0.6.3 + node-sdk example. Repro: call returns `[]` for an empty tool output instead of `{}` and the schema validator (strict) rejects it. Logs: ```
ERROR parse: Unexpected token at position 1
raw_response: \"[\"\"\]\"
```

sam: Can you paste the exact SDK call snippet?

maria: ```js
// node sample
client.call({
  model: 'redwood-rlm',
  json_mode: true,
  tool: 'fetch_user_profile',
  input: { user_id: 'u123' }
})
```

maria: On Python sample it returns `{}` and passes schema. On node it returns `[]` for empty tool payload.

jordan: That smells like our helper that normalizes tool outputs. There's a coercion path in sdk/helpers/json_coerce.ts — might be treating empty string/undefined as array in one branch.

olga: Also saw related flaky failures where auth/retry wrapper re-encodes JSON on retry, producing `"[\"\" ]"` doubles. Could be two separate bugs but they mingle.

sam: repro steps for me: 1) run samplekit with node 18, 2) enable json_mode + strict schema, 3) stub tool to return empty. I can reproduce locally.

maria: Minimal failing example attached (stack trace and stub).

devex-bot: Report created: DEVEX-5123 — "node sdk json_mode empty-tool-output coerce-to-array" (assigned to @jordan)

jordan: I'll triage. Quick hypothesis: Node SDK's JSON helper tries `JSON.parse` but if parse fails it falls back to `safeWrap` that returns Array when input is falsy. I pushed a branch with extra guard: https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/pull/2345

tyler: FYI, we had a prior PY/TS parity issue where `json_mode: true` defaulted to different streaming behavior. That was patch in PR #2101. Might be a regression.

jordan: I ran unit tests and added a case for empty-tool-output => should return `{}` not `[]`. If CI passes I'll merge and cut a patch.

olga: For the auth/retry double encode, I think the retry layer base64-encodes payload for logging and then stringifies again on exception path. That produces quoted arrays. I can open a hotfix PR for the retry wrapper.

sam: Suggestion: make schema validator accept both array and object for that endpoint temporarily so onboarding isn't blocked. But prefer fix at helper.

maria: Can we get a patch release for samplekit docs/instructions? A lot of new users hit this on first run and it's hurting DX.

jordan: I'll cut a 0.6.4 patch for node-sdk tonight and add migration note in samplekit README.

tyler: Also add an integration test in samplekit that runs the Node and Python flows and asserts identical tool outputs (coercion parity). That should catch regressions.

maria: Thanks — can someone add a short blurb in the onboarding checklist so SWE instructors know to bump samplekit if they hit this?

devex-bot: DEVEX-5123 status: in_progress (assignee: jordan).

sam: I'll follow up and verify with a fresh sign-up user tomorrow morning.

jordan: PR merged to main and cherry-picked to v0.6.x: https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/commit/ab12cd3 — includes guard and unit test. Releasing 0.6.4 now.

maria: Verified 0.6.4 fixes the empty-tool-output -> returns `{}` and schema passes. Thanks! :tada:

olga: Opened a separate ticket DEVEX-5124 for the retry double-encode; assigned to me.

maria: Marking thread resolved for onboarding flow. We'll keep the parity integration test in the samplekit CI as follow-up.

jordan: Thanks all.
